page.overview:
Who is Oona Byrn?

Oona Byrn was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Oona Byrn travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Venesir Ask, Roella Ramsby, Eulalia Harthorn, Ansel Virro, Bianca Bagetti and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group tp dine with them.

Byrn attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Ramsby and Bagetti. The attendants all drank poisoned wine and their the masks were also poisoned and sealed to their faces. Byrn attempted to remove her mask, tearing off half of her face before she fainted and died. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.
